newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania revises wheat crop down to 7.07 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Romania revises wheat crop down to 7.07 mln tonnes.

text.p: Romania forecasts a wheat harvest of 7.07 million tonnes this year, down from a previous eight million tonnes estimate but more than double last year's 3.1 million tonne crop, a farm ministry official said on Friday.
The figure for the country's wheat exports, previously seen at 2.4 million tonnes from the 1997 crop was not revised.

"Our previous estimate of eight million tonnes was made before a complete analysis of the situation in the field. Now we have finished our evaluation and we expect a 7.07 million wheat crop," ministry spokeswoman Aurelia Sadagorschi.
She said the revised wheat crop estimate exceeded by far Romania's domestic consumption needs. The ministry would go ahead with plans to export 2.4 million tonnes of this year's bumper crop.

Last year Romania had a poor wheat crop of some 3.1 million tonnes, due to bad weather and a late winter. In 1995, the country, once a grain basket of Europe, harvested a bumper crop of 7.8 million tonnes and sold about 1.3 million tonnes.
Ministry forecasts put at 1.74 million tonnes the wheat crop to be harvested from state farms, with private farmers to harvest the remaining 5.34 million tonnes (figures rounded upwards).
